description: Driving cell selection in the Svelte 5 data grid from code. api.selectCells([[r1, c1, r2, c2]]) selects a rectangle, api.getSelected() reads the current rectangles, and onCellSelectionChange fires for both programmatic and mouse-driven changes. A live panel computes sum, average, min and max over the selected cells with api.getCellValue, alongside an event log and a copy-as-TSV button.

faq.question: How do I select a range from a button?
faq.answer: Call api.selectCells with one or more [startRow, startCol, endRow, endCol] arrays. The selection renders exactly as if the user had dragged it, and onCellSelectionChange fires with the new ranges.

faq.question: How do I compute totals over the selection?
faq.answer: Read api.getSelected() for the rectangles, loop over the rows and columns in each and read values with api.getCellValue. The demo does this in a $derived that re-runs on every selection event.

faq.question: Are indexes based on the displayed order?
faq.answer: Yes. Row and column indexes refer to what is displayed after sorting, filtering and column reordering, so the same coordinates the user sees are the ones the API uses.
